mods.name: Smithing Template Enchantments
mods.description: Enhances smithing templates by adding enchantments to armor when applying trims. Features configurable enchantments, material-based level scaling, and slot restrictions.

releases.notes:
SmithingTemplateEnchantments 1.0.0
- Turns every smithing template into an enchantment carrier with guaranteed prefix enchants plus probabilistic postfix rolls that scale with the material you add.
- Supports rerolling by reusing templates and any configured dust item, enforcing slot restrictions and level caps from `trim_data.json` and `material_data.json`.
- Injects template-specific loot so vanilla and datapack tables can drop pre-enchanted templates, tuned by `loot_config.json` probabilities and min/max rolls.
- Shows clear tooltips for stored prefix/postfix enchants and obfuscates smithing results until applied, making it harder to cheat.
- Ships fully data-driven configs (`material_data.json`, `trim_data.json`, `probabilities_data.json`, `loot_config.json`) so servers can rebalance odds, gating, and compatible materials without code changes.
